name: TimeMachine
description: This application provides a Samba based Time Machine network share. It can be configured to support multiple or single users and restrict the maximum size used for Time Machine backups.

paths.name: Time Machine Backup Data
paths.description: Directory to store the time machine backups. If you change the User Name (TM_USERNAME) value that it will change the data path from /opt/timemachine to /opt/value-of-TM_USERNAME.

variables.name: Size Limit
variables.description: Limits the reported disksize, thus preventing Time Machine from using the whole real disk space for backup. The option takes a number plus an optional unit (e.g. 1 T for 1 Terrabyte). IMPORTANT: This is an approximated calculation that only takes into account the contents of Time Machine sparsebundle images. Therefore you MUST NOT use this volume to store other content when using this option, because it would NOT be accounted. The calculation works by reading the band size from the Info.plist XML file of the sparsebundle, reading the bands/ directory counting the number of band files, and then multiplying one with the other.

variables.name: User Name
variables.description: sets the username time machine runs as

variables.name: User Password
variables.description: sets the password for the timemachine user. The default value is Z92efVNcokU26x.

variables.name: Advertised Hostname
variables.description: Avahi will advertise the smb services at this hostname instead of the local hostname

variables.name: Use Custom SMB Configuration
variables.description: indicates that you are going to bind mount a custom config to /etc/samba/smb.conf if set to true

variables.name: Custom User
variables.description: indicates that you are going to bind mount /etc/password, /etc/group, and /etc/shadow; and create data directories if set to true

variables.name: Debug Level
variables.description: sets the debug level for nmbd and smbd

variables.name: Mimic Model
variables.description: sets the value of time machine to mimic (e.g. TimeCapsule8,119 or TimeCapsule6,116)

variables.name: External Configuration Directory
variables.description: specifies a directory in which individual variable files, ending in .conf. In order to add multiple users who have their own shares, you will need to create a file for each user and put them in a directory.

variables.name: Hide Shares
variables.description: set to yes if you would like only the share(s) a user can access to appear

variables.name: Group Name
variables.description: sets the group name time machine runs as

variables.name: User UID
variables.description: sets the UID of the Executing User (TM_USERNAME)

variables.name: Set Permissions
variables.description: set to true to have the entrypoint set ownership and permission on the /opt/ in the container

variables.name: SMB Inherit Permissions
variables.description: if yes, permissions for new files will be forced to match the parent folder

variables.name: SMB fruit:nfs_aces
variables.description: value of fruit:nfs_aces; support for querying and modifying the UNIX mode of directory entries via NFS ACEs

variables.name: SMB fruit:metadata
variables.description: value of fruit:metadata; controls where the OS X metadata stream is stored

variables.name: SMB Port
variables.description: sets the port that Samba will be available on

variables.name: SMB vfs objects
variables.description: value of vfs objects

variables.name: SMB Workgroup Name
variables.description: set the SMB workgroup name

variables.name: Group GID
variables.description: sets the GID of the TM_GROUPNAME group

variables.name: Share Name
variables.description: sets the name of the timemachine share to.
